# Synced skills — do not edit here

Every directory beside this file is generated. The source of truth is `docs/skills/` in the private `Metronome-Industries/api` repository, and a GitHub Action mirrors it here on merge.

Edits made in this repository are reverted by the next sync, which wipes and rewrites each skill directory. This README is one of the few files the sync preserves, which is why the notice lives here.

To propose a change, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). Metronome engineers open a pull request against `docs/skills/` in the `api` repo; everyone else opens an issue.

`../.skills-sync.json` records which commit of the `api` repo the current contents came from.
